collections.surgeries.surgery_open_dista: After entry into the abdominal cavity, {assistant_name} shifts retraction toward the upper abdomen, while {scrub_name} organizes the suction, retraction, and hemostatic instruments needed for the gastric procedure; {circulator_name} readjusts the lighting. Reduce intermediate adjustments to obtain distal mobility as soon as possible

Reconfirm the distal margin and surrounding relationships before transection

Confirm specimen handoff and proceed to reconstruction preparation

Before reconstruction begins, {assistant_name} returns the gastric remnant and the digestive tract segment intended for anastomosis to their natural positions, confirming that the two ends can meet without excessive traction; {scrub_name} prepares anastomotic and suturing materials. Check apposition and tension step by step to complete reconstruction carefully
Complete the anastomosis at a normal pace
Reduce intermediate adjustments to complete reconstruction as soon as possible

Revise only the area most in need of attention, then proceed to the final check as soon as possible
